lessons.correction: Maintain your ground army and continue expanding, but add anti-air units like Marines or Thors to counter potential Void Rays.
lessons.mistake: Sticking to a pure ground composition without anti-air, leaving your army vulnerable to Void Rays.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if the opponent commits heavily to air or if you need to adjust your composition.
lessons.title: Anti-Air Gap vs Void Rays
lessons.when: Midgame, around 420 seconds, with a heavy ground army and economy, and enemy scouting shows Zealots and Void Rays.
lessons.why: Your ground army is strong, but Void Rays threaten it. Adding anti-air ensures you can handle mixed compositions.

lessons.correction: Increase your anti-air capabilities by adding Thors, Vikings, or more Marines, while continuing to strengthen your ground army and maintain economy.
lessons.mistake: Continuing to strengthen ground forces without adding anti-air, leaving you unable to fight the enemy's air-heavy army.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if the opponent transitions to more ground or if you need to adjust your composition.
lessons.title: Insufficient Anti-Air vs Heavy Air
lessons.when: Midgame, around 480 seconds, with a heavy ground army and economy, and enemy scouting shows Zealots, Stalkers, Phoenixes, and Observers.
lessons.why: The opponent's air army is strong, but your heavy economy allows a tech switch to support your ground with anti-air.

lessons.correction: Maintain your ground army but start preparing anti-air by adding Marines and possibly Thors or Vikings, while continuing to expand and tech.
lessons.mistake: Over-investing in anti-air or abandoning your ground army in response to Oracle harassment.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you see more air units (e.g., Phoenix, Void Rays) or if the opponent switches back to ground.
lessons.title: Overreacting to Oracles
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 300 seconds, with a heavy ground army and economy, and enemy scouting shows Zealots and Oracles.
lessons.why: Oracles can harass, but your economy is strong. Adding anti-air defends against air threats without sacrificing your ground core.
